Cms.//AllowedUsers: Who may sign in and publish. Email, UPN or Entra object id. Empty denies everyone.

GitHub.//Branch: The branch GitHub Pages builds from — see .github/workflows/deploy.yml. Not main.
GitHub.//Token: Set in App Service configuration, never here. Fine-grained PAT, Contents: read and write.

Storage.//: Leave empty to stage posters on local disk. Set ServiceUri to use managed identity.

ConnectionStrings.//Cms: Azure SQL. Empty falls back to a local SQLite file so the app runs with no Azure account.
ConnectionStrings.//Storage: Blob connection string. Prefer Storage:ServiceUri with managed identity in production.
